text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 
I will head straight to the track this 
afternoon, then.
choice_data_list: All right, sounds good.
Sounds good, see you then.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact~? 
Let's go, all the seats are gonna fill up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right away! 
Excuse me, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Have fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact seems to be settling in at 
Tracen Academy, 
and I've started seeing her hang out 
with friends more often.
choice_data_list: (Alright, time for me to get to work too!)
(Alright, time for me to get to work too!)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*... Okay, real talk, everyone! 
Once you debut, what kind of path 
do you want to take?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What kind of path... meaning?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I'm going for the Classic Triple Crown 
route, no question! 
...And then winning the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(The Classic Triple Crown route... 
One of the premier paths open 
only to Classic-tier horsegirls.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Composed of three races: the Satsuki Sho, 
the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho. 
Winning the Derby, above all, is said to 
be the highest honor...)

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
I want to break course records. 
I'll leave my name in history with times 
nobody can ever beat!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I see... That's certainly one metric...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
As for me... I want to take on the world! 
As a Japanese horsegirl, 
I'll win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... 
and fulfill that long-cherished dream!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...! 
France's pinnacle GⅠ race. Japanese 
horsegirls 
have challenged it countless times... but 
none have won yet.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone has set their sights on such 
lofty ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! I mean, look around, 
everyone here is insanely talented! 
Either from famous clubs or with crazy raw 
skill...

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but out of all of us, 
aren't you the most impressive one, Daring 
Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But I was never 
even part of a training club...

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
And you still made it into Tracen Academy, 
plus you already have a trainer assigned! 
That's downright amazing!

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
I'm super curious to see 
what kind of path you're gonna take, 
Daring Tact~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: My... path...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That afternoon, Daring Tact contacted me 
saying she wanted to talk before training 
started. 
What she shared with me was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
'To become a horsegirl who leaves her mark 
on history, 
and prove just how wonderful my hometown 
is.'

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is, without a doubt, my dream. 
However, I haven't really thought through 
which path I need to take to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of me... stretches only 
a pure white snowfield without a single 
footprint.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, which path do you think 
would be best for me to take?
choice_data_list: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has only just begun serious training. 
It certainly wouldn't be too late to think 
about it 
after her debut, but...
choice_data_list: (Having a goal is a great thing!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I could make the decision for her, but 
ideally, 
I'd like to give her hints so she can 
discover the path for herself.
choice_data_list:
Tact, is there a race you've always 
admired?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let me think... 
I don't believe I have a specific race in 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To me, all races felt like something 
distant, 
existing only on the other side of the 
screen.
choice_data_list: Then... what about a horsegirl you admire?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A horsegirl I admire...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Daring Heart.
choice_data_list: Daring Heart?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Daring Heart... 
She was the very first upperclassman 
I connected with here at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Despite her sophisticated urban air, she 
knows the mountains well, 
and she's so brilliant and tough—she's 
someone I truly look up to.
choice_data_list:
In that case, let's watch some of Daring 
Heart's races.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This might actually be the first time 
I'll be taking a proper look at her races.
choice_data_list:
She has been taking a break from racing 
for a while, after all.

She has been taking a break from racing 
for a while, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We browse through footage as we talk. What 
catches my eye 
is from early in her long career— 
the first leg of the Classic races, the 
Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Oka Sho. In this race... 
if I recall correctly, Daring Heart 
finished third.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, she didn't win. But this is the one 
to see.

Yeah, she didn't win. But this is the one 
to see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart and Others
text_block_list.text: "HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............!! 
This... raw intensity...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This Oka Sho was a race where Daring 
Heart's 
greatest rivals all gathered together. 
Perhaps that's why it left such a strong 
impression—
choice_data_list: Take a look at Daring Heart's expression.
Look at Daring Heart's expression.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Haa... haa...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: How... magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Tore-san. 
Could you play that again from the 
beginning?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course.
Sure, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, Daring Tact 
remained glued 
to the screen, watching Daring Heart's 
race over and over. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I—I want to take 
the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route is the other major 
Classic-tier path, 
essentially serving as the counterpart 
to the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Races that test contenders across three 
events: 
the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back then, every race I watched on 
television 
seemed to sparkle before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
But Daring Heart's race... was so much 
more intense— 
I couldn't tear my eyes away for even a 
second.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to run that same path and clothe 
myself 
in that very same radiance...!
choice_data_list:
Then it's settled. Let's aim for the Tiara 
route!

Then it's settled. Let's aim for the Tiara 
route!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Tact decided on her path, 
reaching out to follow in the footsteps 
of the runner she so deeply admired.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow, really!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I see. 
You're taking the Tiara route, too...
choice_data_list: By the way, what's with the giant dice...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mind that! We were just throwing 
a little party, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen up, everyone! 
She says she wants to run the Tiara route! 
—Following right in my footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"That is SO like you, Heart~♪" 
"Love that for you! ♡" "Tact has 
such amazing taste~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, goodness, I couldn't be happier! 
Thank you so much, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If there's ever anything I can do, just 
say the word! 
I'll support you however I can!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's very reassuring. 
Though I really just came to let you know—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back, ask her anything! 
Heart's super incredible, so lean on her 
all you want!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! She's from the Hillesta Academy, 
so she's top elite♡"
choice_data_list: From *the* Hillesta Academy...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That famous training club, right? 
There are a few students from there in our 
class, too... 
I see, so Daring Heart was also..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...What's this, are you curious? 
Hmm, let me see..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Okay, then—I'll take you there!

title: Tracks Found in Pure White Snow
